name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; no Ghidra address residue; descriptor accurately captures the function's role (play a rising pre-cast/sparkle effect). Although it is reused beyond spell pre-cast (chapter-23 ending and AI item use), the name is still descriptive and not misleading, so keep.
purpose: Plays a 10-frame rising 'sparkle' band effect anchored at a unit's screen position, used both as a spell pre-effect (spell 0xB/0xC) and as a generic summon/chapter-event rising sparkle.
logic_summary: Computes caster screen x/y from runtime_char_array[caster_unit_id].pos_x/pos_y minus the battle view-window origin, scaled by 0x18 plus a fixed offset. malloc's a 0x25680 backdrop snapshot and composites the battle tile map into it. Loops frame 0..9: reads a self-relative sprite offset from the 10-entry tile-anim table (base + 6 + frame*4 + base), restores the snapshot into the large game-state buffer via memmove, draws the filled circle/anim row at the caster screen pos with the current height (initial_height accumulator), repaints all unit sprites over it, then blits the composed scene to the mode-13h framebuffer at 0xA0504; after each frame initial_height += rise_step. Frees the snapshot, composites a final battle frame, then returns (binary tail-JMPs to the shared inline-epilogue fragment fd2_noop_stub_b43 @ 0x10b43).
signature: void fd2_play_rising_pre_cast_effect(int caster_unit_id, int initial_height, int rise_step)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (0x50-byte stride); identifies the unit whose screen position anchors the rising effect.
params.reason: Accurately names the runtime-char array index; no address residue.

params.name: initial_height
params.semantics: Starting circle-band radius/height passed to fd2_render_circle_anim_row on frame 0; serves as the per-frame accumulator (grows by rise_step each frame).
params.reason: Matches caller intent (e.g. 0xF for spell 0xB) and body usage as the rising height accumulator; no address residue.

params.name: rise_step
params.semantics: Per-frame increment added to the height/radius after each of the 10 frames (rise speed).
params.reason: Matches caller intent (e.g. 0xA for spell 0xB) and body usage as the per-frame radius increment; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs the animation as a side effect and leaves the final battle frame composited.

comment_original_issue: Source comment block was accurate and comprehensive but contained three non-ASCII em-dash characters (U+2014) on the param lines (caster_unit_id / initial_height / rise_step), violating the ASCII-only code-text rule.

Ghidra plate left as-is (consistent with refined understanding). Verified param semantics via caller fd2_cast_spell_0b_with_prefx @ 0x2185f which passes (caster, 0xF=initial_height, 0xA=rise_step).
